newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines co-chair Checchi resigns.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines co-chair Checchi resigns.

text.p: Northwest Airlines said Friday that board Co-Chairman Al Checchi has submitted his resignation, which is effective immediately.
Northwest said that Checchi, who is intensifying his exploration of a possible candidacy for governor of California, will continue to serve as a member of the board.
The company said Gary Wilson was appointed chairman of the Northwest board.
Wilson, who was co-chairman before the appointment, is a principal investor in the airline's parent, NWA Inc.
He is also a director of Walt Disney Co, which he joined in 1985 and in which he served as executive vice president and chief financial officer until 1990.
Before joining Disney, he served in various executive positions for 11 years at hotelier Marriott Corp.
In announcing his resignation, Checchi said his years at the airline company have been "exciting and deeply gratifying."
"I am proud of what we have achieved and look forward to continuing my relationship with the company as an active board member and long-term investor," he said.
"As my attention turns more to public service, this seems an appropriate step for me, for my family and for Northwest." he added.
